name: ondimi-weddings
description: Run your wedding's guest communication from ChatGPT: import your guest list, collect RSVPs and mailing addresses, answer guest questions, and send updates you approve, through onDimi's AI guest concierge.

interface.longDescription:
onDimi Weddings connects ChatGPT to your wedding on onDimi, an AI guest concierge that texts, emails, calls and chats with every guest party for you. Every call it places or answers opens by saying who is speaking: "it's onDimi, the AI guest concierge of <the couple>". Guests are only the couple's own invited guests, in the US, and each channel follows the guest's recorded consent.

Ask how RSVPs are going and get exact numbers and names. Paste your guest list from a spreadsheet or a wedding-website export and ChatGPT imports it, fills in existing guests instead of duplicating them, and shows what changed. Ask the guests you choose for their RSVP or mailing address; onDimi follows up on its own and stops when a guest answers. When something changes, like a new ceremony time or the shuttle schedule, ChatGPT drafts one update, shows you a sample, and sends it only to the guests you approve. Keep the details the concierge uses to answer guests current.

You stay in control. The connection sees only your wedding, reading never changes anything, and nothing reaches a guest until you approve it.

New to onDimi? Create your wedding in the sign-in window. It doesn't contact anyone until you're ready.
defaultPrompt: Help us set up our wedding details.
Send an update to our guests.

positive.expected_behavior: Connected to Chris & Macy Wedding (ChatGPT Reviewer). Reports 98 guests: 76 attending, 14 declined and 8 awaiting a response (90 of 98 responded), with the November 14 RSVP deadline. Changes nothing.

Lists the 14 declined guests by party: Ivy Griffin; Owen and Kate Russell; Derek Bryant; Julian and Maria Rivera; Audrey and Miles Long; Gabriel and Tara Perry; Ethan and Molly Brooks; Noah and Grace Kim. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Add a guest: Alex Rivera, phone 555-555-0199.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Alex Rivera with phone 555-555-0199 as a new guest party and confirms it. No message is sent to the guest.

positive.description: Drafts a guest update without sending
positive.prompt: Draft an update telling our attending guests the ceremony now starts at 4:30 PM, and show me a sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a draft and shows a one-guest sample, e.g. "Hi Ryan, it's Chris & Macy here. The ceremony now starts at 4:30 PM. We look forward to celebrating with you! Reply STOP to opt out.", and states that nothing has been sent. Sending requires a separate approval.

positive.description: Updates the information the concierge uses
positive.prompt: Add to our venue information: shuttles leave the hotel lobby at 3:45 PM and return at 11 PM.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the shuttle times (leave the hotel lobby 3:45 PM, return 11 PM) to the wedding's venue information and confirms the update. Guests are not contacted.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: onDimi is not used; the request has nothing to do with the user's wedding guests.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
negative.expected_behavior: onDimi is not used; the request has nothing to do with the user's wedding guests.

negative.prompt: Book us a honeymoon flight to Cancun.
negative.expected_behavior: onDimi is not used: it manages guest communication, not travel booking.

review.commerce_description: onDimi Weddings does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. The onDimi service itself is free for the reviewer account and for typical weddings.

publication.release_notes:
1.0.6: every tool sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint explicitly (true or false), following OpenAI's plugin guidelines: destructiveHint is false only for writes that purely add; openWorldHint is true when the effect leaves the couple's private account.
Changed in 1.0.6: guest_messages_pause_resume is now destructiveHint true and openWorldHint true (it changes the state of existing messages, and a resumed message is then really sent to the guest; being able to pause again does not make it non-destructive). Changed in 1.0.5: knowledge_update is now openWorldHint true. Changed in 1.0.4: guests_add is now destructiveHint false; guest_messages_pause_resume and guest_messages_cancel are idempotentHint true (repeating the call leaves the same state).
Read-only (readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false), each returns data from the couple's own wedding and changes nothing: wedding_profile, wedding_status_digest, wedding_details, concierge_guide, guest_fields, wedding_fields, guest_list, guest_get, guest_message_history, guest_upcoming_messages, plan_available, plan_preflight (a preview: computes the review and enrolls no one), plan_status, guest_updates_list, knowledge_list, vendor_list.
Additive write (destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false): guests_add only creates guest parties; nothing is overwritten, a duplicate phone fails that row, and nothing is sent.
Writes that overwrite, cancel or remove data inside the couple's account (destructiveHint true, openWorldHint false): wedding_details_update and guest_edit replace field values; plan_guest_status_set changes a guest's plan status and can cancel that guest's pending messages; guest_list_import creates parties and updates matched ones; guest_update_draft rewords an existing draft when update_id is given, replacing its previous text (it sends nothing); guest_messages_cancel cancels pending messages, which cannot be restored; vendor_manage can remove a vendor.
Writes whose effect leaves the account (destructiveHint true, openWorldHint true): guest_update_send delivers an approved message to the chosen guests (cannot be unsent); plan_enroll_guests schedules a plan's texts, emails and calls to the chosen guests; guest_messages_pause_resume pauses pending messages or puts paused ones back on their send times, after which they go out to guests; knowledge_update replaces an entry's text, which the concierge then uses in its answers to guests and which the couple's published wedding website shows. The sending tools require the couple's explicit approval in the conversation first.
